bank_name: Jilla Sahakari Kendriya Bank Maryadit, Gwalior

website_metadata.notes: No working official website. Registry hint yappe.in is a third-party directory. dccbgwalior.in (from the bank email jskbgwl.mp@dccbgwalior.in) is a parked domain that redirects to a '/lander' for-sale page (confirmed: 114-byte JS redirect). No .bank.in / .com variant resolves; MP Apex Bank portal unreachable from here. Other districts' DCC banks (Dewas, Rajnandgaon, Bilaspur) have sites, but Gwalior has none.

warnings: Registry hint domain (yappe.in) is a third-party directory, not the bank.
